macro_regime.regime_guidance: Prior-session VIX spiked above the 24.0 stress threshold and remains elevated (10-day VIX SMA >= 30-day SMA). High-volatility (>= 50 IVR) entries are LOCKED; Core Low-IVR (< 25, <= 0.35% half-spread) Fixed-Slot entries remain eligible up to the 10-slot cap, idle slots earn 3-Month US Treasury Bills, and open positions hold calmly to Day -1.
